name: Bitwise_Orthogonality_Framing
description: Transforms the graph edges into a set of m features (one per edge). Each vertex is described by an m-bit string indicating its incident edges. The independent set condition is reframed as finding k vertices whose bitwise AND for any pair is zero. This shifts the model's pattern matching from graph theory to bitwise string operations, preventing it from using graph-specific pruning heuristics (like degree-based ordering or 64-bit integer adjacency masks), which will cause a Time Limit Exceeded on hard tests.
